channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [repo] relayworkslab/relayworks-recovery
item.description: RelayWorks Recovery is an engine that resumes interrupted AI agent jobs from their last verified checkpoint instead of restarting them entirely.

item.title: [news] Everything is an AI scam now
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from davidralphlewis.co.uk. 134 points and 53 comments.

item.title: [tool] Gauge – Open-Source CLI to recursively improve your docs
item.description: Open-source command-line interface that recursively tests and improves developer documentation, skills, and Model Context Protocol servers for AI coding agents.

item.title: [news] Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra – 150W AI Accelerator Card with 128GB at 548GB/s
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from qualcomm.com. 134 points and 54 comments.

item.title: [paper] From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
item.description: NEO-VLA eliminates fixed visual encoders to let action policies access evolving visual representations across network depths, improving manipulation robustness.

item.title: [paper] A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
item.description: Framework that uses controlled context enrichment and selective robustness as a validation criterion to evaluate LLM social agents and identify reliable behavioral patterns.

item.title: [paper] FlowReconBench: Accuracy, calibration and cost of learned and classical flow reconstruction from sparse sensors
item.description: Benchmark that evaluates ten learned and five classical methods for reconstructing full flow fields from sparse sensors across laminar, turbulent, and 3D regimes.

item.title: [paper] BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
item.description: Expert-curated benchmark containing 1,000 question-answer samples across 11 task types to evaluate multimodal large language models for self-driving chemical laboratories.

item.title: [paper] FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
item.description: FrontierPhysics is an end-to-end benchmark of 56 expert-designed physics tasks that evaluates AI agents on literature review, research planning, experimentation, and manuscript production using deterministic verifiers and expert rubrics.

item.title: [paper] Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation
item.description: Humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across procedural homes to acquire physical skills and transfer zero-shot to the physical world.

item.title: [news] Ripple-65B Preview: U.S. Open-Weight SOTA on Agentic Coding
item.description: Ripple-65B Preview is a dense open-weight language model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens that delivers high performance on agentic coding tasks.

item.title: [paper] Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
item.description: Reinforcement learning approach that enables generalist robot policies to achieve multi-task, online self-improvement and boost performance across diverse deployment tasks simultaneously.

item.title: [paper] Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models
item.description: Motion-guided contrastive regularization method for latent world models that compares predicted latent transitions with episode candidates to prevent static collapse and improve planning success.

item.title: [paper] Occlusion for Free: Detecting Occlusion from the Disagreement Between Two Monocular Distance Cues
item.description: Method that detects heavy pedestrian occlusion using the disagreement between apparent height and monocular metric depth without requiring any training or occlusion labels.

item.title: [paper] Procedural Adversarial Learning
item.description: Procedural adversarial learning framework that searches the input space of a procedural generator using zeroth-order optimization to find difficult test instances and reduce worst-case errors in computer vision models.

item.title: [paper] Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
item.description: Study examining how item groupings and occupational characteristics shape the interpretation of occupational AI exposure estimates across various US jobs.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
item.description: Adaptive Multi Mode framework that dynamically routes a continuous black-box optimization budget among multiple engines using online probes of problem landscapes.

item.title: [paper] SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
item.description: SpecCompact is a framework that accelerates LLM agent context compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation using a fine-tuned small drafter and target model verification.

item.title: [paper] Learning to Decode Linear Codes with Generalized Belief Propagation Network
item.description: Generalized Belief Propagation Network is a neural decoder for linear codes that preserves message-passing symmetry and uses cascaded variable-node updates to achieve lower bit error rates.

item.title: [paper] PixelSpline: Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution via Endpoint-Anchored Shared Pixel Trajectories
item.description: Continuous space-time video super-resolution framework that uses endpoint-anchored pixel trajectories to warp endpoint colors and align features for consistent motion reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
item.description: Turn-level best-of-N sampling inference-time scaling approach that uses a generator-selector framework to improve accuracy and consistency in LLM agents on complex tasks.

item.title: [paper] CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification
item.description: Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval is an evaluation protocol that uses different view masks to determine whether animal identification models rely on actual animal features or background shortcuts.

item.title: [paper] Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings
item.description: Empirical benchmark study investigating the performance trade-offs of combining hierarchical text representations with numerical quantization to improve embedding storage efficiency.

item.title: [paper] CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
item.description: Framework called CompressionBench that evaluates how coding agents autonomously compress large language models to improve inference storage efficiency.

item.title: [paper] LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
item.description: Benchmark called LongBanana that evaluates expert-verified, long-context multi-reference image synthesis tasks for agent-driven image generation systems.

item.title: [paper] Regression with Many Generated Controls
item.description: Methodology for linear regression with latent endogeneity that uses multiple proxy variables generated by AI and machine learning methods to consistently estimate parameters without validation data.

item.title: [paper] Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
item.description: Training framework called Visual Token Routing that uses a spatio-temporal router to select relevant visual tokens, reducing computational costs for computer-use agents.

item.title: [paper] Trainspotting: Learning Object-Centric 3D Reconstruction from Found Photos
item.description: Dataset called Trainspotting containing Wikimedia Commons objects and photos to improve object-centric 3D reconstruction and camera pose estimation in feedforward models.

item.title: [paper] Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
item.description: Study demonstrating that prompting large language models to adopt political personas systematically alters their internal representations and safety-relevant evaluation metrics.

item.title: [paper] Navigating Disagreement Among Criteria for Evaluating Explanation Faithfulness
item.description: Analytical framework for evaluating explanation faithfulness that locates operational disagreements in model claims, comparisons, and aggregations to help auditors navigate conflicting criteria.

item.title: [paper] Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
item.description: Routing mechanism called Dynamic Gated Pathways that establishes all-to-all connections between vision encoder and language model layers to improve multimodal model performance.

item.title: [paper] Thermally Conditioned Time-Series Forecasting of Grain Growth in Polycrystalline Materials
item.description: Recurrent neural network framework that incorporates thermal descriptors to forecast grain size distributions and growth dynamics in polycrystalline materials under non-isothermal conditions.

item.title: [paper] ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
item.description: Benchmark called ServerBench that evaluates coding agents on designing and optimizing specialized, verified large language model serving systems based on latency and GPU cost.

item.title: [paper] Same Layout, Different Count: What Number Words Do Past Ten in Text-to-Image Models
item.description: Researchers evaluate how five open text-to-image models handle number words beyond ten objects, finding that layout and object count often decouple past this threshold.

item.title: [paper] Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
item.description: Researchers introduce TASC, a benchmark to evaluate whether conversational large language models apply time-dependent constraints when responding to user requests.

item.title: [paper] Context-Aware Autoregressive Image Generation for Emerging Reasoning Properties
item.description: Researchers propose a context-aware autoregressive image generation framework that dynamically determines the next token location based on global context and local information to improve structural robustness and reasoning capabilities.

item.title: [paper] Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token
item.description: Researchers introduce context-answer metamodels that map context activation sequences to forecast mean-pooled answer activations and rollout variability in language models before the first token is generated.

item.title: [paper] LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
item.description: Researchers propose LooM, a loop-invariant memory method for causal encoder-decoder language models that uses shared layer execution with a fixed-size cache to provide variable compute budgets at deployment.

item.title: [paper] Alignment Myopia in Generative AI
item.description: Researchers propose a paradigm shift toward long-horizon alignment in generative AI that accounts for how persistent human-AI interaction shapes long-term human well-being and avoids adverse outcomes like cognitive atrophy.

item.title: [paper] Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS
item.description: Researchers present an end-to-end development toolchain and methodology using high-level Vitis HLS to implement machine learning models on AWS cloud FPGA infrastructure.

item.title: [paper] Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
item.description: Researchers propose Systolic Linear Attention, a hardware-co-designed attention layer that reshapes gated delta attention around Google TPU matrix units to achieve faster training and pre-training speeds.

item.title: [paper] Rules, Traces and Routing Statistics: Training and Calibration Data for Open Models on ARC-AGI-2
item.description: Researchers study the impact of training data and offline inference procedures on open models solving ARC-AGI-2 tasks, showing significant performance gains from targeted fine-tuning and inference optimizations.

item.title: [paper] GFlowQEC: Generative Flow Networks that Learn to Sample Quantum LDPC Codes
item.description: Researchers introduce GFlowQEC, a generative flow network method that learns to sample quantum LDPC codes to efficiently discover high-scoring codes despite slow circuit-level simulations.

item.title: [paper] Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
item.description: Open-HumanScale introduces an open recipe and a 50,000-hour egocentric video corpus to scale pretraining for robot learning, achieving high success rates on simulation and physical benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
item.description: SAUCE is a reference-free evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization that measures summary accuracy and fact coverage through text entailment.

item.title: [paper] Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
item.description: Evolutionary design of interpretable spatial descriptors optimizes spatial partitions and pooling operations using a genetic algorithm to improve structure-property relationship discovery in image-based regression tasks.

item.title: [paper] LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
item.description: FinDendro is a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts used to demonstrate that large language models cannot be certified leak-free for financial backtesting through self-reporting or stated knowledge cutoffs.

item.title: [paper] Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
item.description: Measuring risk rather than harm, a response-level behavioral risk-factor detection framework provides a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring in large language model conversations.

item.title: [paper] Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
item.description: Task-efficient agent evaluation uses LLM-extracted summary embeddings of execution traces to predict new system performance and reduce benchmarking errors.

item.title: [paper] ConDR: Conservative Reachability through Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Subsolutions
item.description: Conservative DeepReach is a neural Hamilton-Jacobi reachability method that learns a subsolution to ensure computed unsafe sets contain true system failures for safe control.

item.title: [paper] Message-passing graph persistence
item.description: Message-Passing Graph Persistence is a family of topological descriptors that incorporates graph neural network message passing into filtrations to improve graph classification and regression.

item.title: [paper] VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation
item.description: Velocity Adversarial Distillation and trajectory-aware supervision enable high-quality few-step diffusion and flow generation with state-of-the-art results.

item.title: [paper] Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3
item.description: SARBLOH is an open-weight agent that uses a zero-parameter spatial perception engine and code-as-action runtime to rapidly model unfamiliar interactive visual environments on ARC-AGI-3.

item.title: [paper] Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors
item.description: Acceptance predictors for academic papers show that agreement on original paper rankings does not translate to agreement on paragraph-edit scores.

item.title: [paper] Fundamental Limits of Coherent Imaging in The Presence of Atmospheric Turbulence
item.description: We study the fundamental limits of jointly estimating the signal amplitude and the atmospheric phase distortion in complex-valued multi-look coherent imaging, where the measurements are corrupted by multiplicative speckle and additive Gaussian noise, all looks share a known…

item.title: [paper] FedFiOT: Fisher-Weighted Optimal Transport for Model Merging in One-Shot and Few-Round Federated Learning
item.description: Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework called FedFiOT aligns neurons and aggregates models in one-shot and few-round federated learning to overcome client drift and heterogeneity.

item.title: [paper] Semantic Residual Vector Quantization for Sign Language Generation
item.description: Semantic Residual Vector Quantization framework for sign language generation breaks down sentence translation into a two-level process moving from semantic content to detailed kinematic motion.

item.title: [paper] Regularization vs. Convolution in Kernel-Based Hypothesis Testing
item.description: The maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) test is a popular nonparametric test on general domains. Two lines of work have studied its optimality through structurally different approaches.

item.title: [paper] WISE: An Agentic Framework for Whole-page Multimodal Search Experience Attribution
item.description: Agentic framework named WISE diagnoses system quality issues in industrial search by discovering user-facing problems and tracing their origins back to underlying algorithmic components.

item.title: [paper] Benchmarking Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning for Remote Sensing in Urban Management
item.description: Benchmark called UMBench evaluates fine-grained visual reasoning for urban remote sensing tasks and shows that an evidence-first chain-of-thought method improves multimodal model performance.

item.title: [paper] Route First, See Later: Enabling Vision Agents to Reason Scientifically by Separating Routing Policy from Action Spaces
item.description: Extensible architecture named ZETA separates routing policy from action execution in scientific vision agents to improve reliability and auditability during image-analysis workflows.

item.title: [paper] Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks
item.description: Weighted variant of L2 regularization for diagonal linear networks extends beneficial sparsity bias to continual learning, yielding faster convergence when learning from sparse teachers.

item.title: [paper] EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
item.description: Brain-renderer collaboration framework called EvoWorld uses a vision-language model to reason about state transitions and guide a video renderer in generating causally consistent world evolution.

item.title: [paper] TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
item.description: Training framework called TailSteer improves drift-resistant multi-turn image editing by concentrating preservation corrections near the trajectory tail of on-policy denoising rollouts.

item.title: [paper] Coupled Scene Graph Anticipation: When With-Constraint Recall Hides Structural Inconsistency
item.description: CoupledSGA proposes a relationship interaction graph and structural consistency loss for video scene graph anticipation to prevent mutually exclusive object relationship predictions.

item.title: [paper] Smartphone-Aided VR Exergames for HIIT: Gamifying Fitness with Real-Time Pose Estimation
item.description: Smartphone-Aided VR Exergames for HIIT introduces a virtual reality exergame system using smartphone pose estimation and large language models to provide real-time workout assessments.

item.title: [paper] ConceptARC at Scale: Studying Conceptual Understanding in Reasoning Models
item.description: ConceptARC at Scale introduces a task generator and a 1,600-task dataset to evaluate abstract reasoning and conceptual understanding in large reasoning models.

item.title: [paper] Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
item.description: Template gap reconstruction uses reusable output literals with autoregressively generated gaps to improve shell output simulation fidelity and reduce token generation in small language models.

item.title: [paper] Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
item.description: TurnWise improves streaming video understanding by assigning turn-level credit and balancing decision weights in group relative policy optimization.

item.title: [paper] Dexterous Robotic Hands in the Foundation-Model Era: A Full-Stack Survey of Hardware, Data, Cross-Embodiment Transfer, Learning, and Evaluation
item.description: This paper surveys advancements in dexterous robotic hands from hardware and data collection to cross-embodiment transfer, learning, and evaluation.

item.title: [paper] Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis
item.description: This study uses central flow dynamics to analyze how gradient flow conservation laws evolve and break at the edge of stability in neural networks.

item.title: [paper] Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
item.description: Rel-Bloom is a multilingual diagnostic benchmark used to evaluate evidence-conditioned relational reasoning and non-parametric memory in language models.

item.title: [paper] Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
item.description: Energy-Guided Transport introduces a training-free framework that applies a continuous dissipative force via automatic differentiation to guide generative physics models toward physical constraints.

item.title: [paper] Beyond the principle-practice gap: Responsible AI as situated epistemic and ethical practice
item.description: This paper examines how institutional and professional conditions shape ethical practices and agency in the design and governance of AI systems.

item.title: [paper] ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
item.description: ALTO is a community-led multilingual dataset of tech-facilitated gender-based violence instances in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili for improving harm detection models.

item.title: [paper] Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
item.description: Vision-language agent study in Pac-Man investigates perception and policy failures, showing that textual board representations dramatically improve maze completion rates.

item.title: [paper] Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation
item.description: Three-stage pathology framework integrates automated screening, generative representation learning, and lightweight adaptation to achieve state-of-the-art semantic segmentation performance.

item.title: [paper] PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging
item.description: Physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation framework performs EEG extended-source imaging without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining.

item.title: [paper] Don't Replace, Complement: A Detector-Agnostic Subspace Signal for Near-OOD Detection
item.description: Per-class Low-dimensional sUbspace Signal is a targeted score fused additively with base detectors to consistently improve near-out-of-distribution detection performance.

item.title: [paper] LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
item.description: LifeVal is a consumer task benchmark evaluating personalized AI digital superassistant performance across valuable life tasks.

item.title: [paper] Sekai: Incremental Event Memory for Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation
item.description: Sekai is an online framework with structured memory and a memory-grounded decoder that significantly outperforms existing online reasoning video segmentation methods.

item.title: [paper] SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
item.description: SecureGARD is a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework that achieves a zero percent attack success rate against indirect prompt injections in tool-using LLM agents.

item.title: [paper] Do unlearning algorithms learn the right features?
item.description: Feature recovery measure evaluates machine unlearning methods, revealing that models passing standard metrics often fail to recover retrained features.

item.title: [paper] Self-Directed Apple Tasting
item.description: Study of the self-directed apple-tasting setting establishes a tetrachotomy on the expected minimax number of mistakes for online learners based on specific dimensions.

item.title: [paper] AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
item.description: AgentTrustCI is a Java and JUnit 5 testing framework that expresses application-layer policy, grounding, and trajectory checks for LLM agents over recorded traces.

item.title: [paper] CardioDrift: Automatic Cardiac Motion Tracking on a 3D Atlas Mesh via Shape-aware Coherent Point Drift with Slice Shift Correction
item.description: CardioDrift is an automatic, atlas-based probabilistic framework that tracks subject-specific cardiac motion on a 3D atlas mesh to quantify myocardial motion abnormalities.

item.title: [paper] Where Search Agents Go Off the Rails: Graph-Grounded Step-Level Verification
item.description: GraphRail is a verification system that represents requirements, evidence, and reasoning as structured claims to audit search-augmented reasoning systems without a generative judge.

item.title: [paper] Fingerprinting the Dispatchers behind Distributed Model Extraction
item.description: Request timing analysis can forensically rank accounts used in distributed model extraction campaigns by revealing underlying dispatching strategies like round-robin counters or key-shuffling pools.

item.title: [paper] Beyond accuracy: what AI assurance needs to establish in public services
item.description: Evaluations of GPT-4o configurations classifying political questions reveal that output consistency and high accuracy do not guarantee alignment with human coding or correctness.

item.title: [paper] Detecting Silent Action-Interface Mismatch with Calibrated Relational World Models
item.description: Learned state-action-effect relations serve as offline contracts for detecting silent action-interface mismatches in robots and ranking their likely fields.

item.title: [paper] Dynamical State-Space Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Prediction
item.description: Dynamical State-Space Diffusion is a temporal prediction model that learns the temporal structure of the noise corruption process using stable diagonal state-space models.

item.title: [news] OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company
item.description: https://twitter.com/pierrecomputer/status/211799903617518818...

item.title: [paper] Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
item.description: A probabilistic standard and stacked ensemble of open-weight models are introduced to address reproducibility problems and improve estimation precision in LLM social science research.

item.title: [paper] Human Motion Prediction via Continual Prior Compensation
item.description: Continual Prior Compensation is a temporal continual learning framework that progressively trains human motion prediction models across varied temporal moments to prevent short-term learning interference.

item.title: [paper] Uncertainty-Driven Efficient Communication for UAV-Based Collaborative Perception
item.description: UCP is an uncertainty-driven framework that uses observational and discriminative uncertainty estimates to optimize inter-agent communication for UAV-based collaborative perception.

item.title: [paper] TestBED: An Open-Source Toolkit for Bayesian Experimental Design
item.description: TestBED is a general-purpose, open-source toolkit that decomposes Bayesian experimental design into modular components to facilitate method implementation, comparison, and benchmarking.

item.title: [paper] Trick-or-Treat: Adversarial Evaluation of Multimodal Medical Reasoning with Synthetic Images
item.description: Evaluation framework called Trick-or-Treat pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to expose hallucination behaviors in multimodal frontier medical models.

item.title: [paper] Noise-regularized training of quantum circuit Born machines under a finite shot budget
item.description: Quantum circuit Born machines training framework called GENIE uses noise-regularized training with capped error mitigation and held-out data to optimize generalization under a finite shot budget.

item.title: [paper] Does Frontier AI Strengthen Cyber Defense? Evidence from Project Glasswing
item.description: Study of Project Glasswing shows that early access to frontier AI model Claude Mythos Preview helped tech firms find and fix significantly more software vulnerabilities before attackers exploited them.

item.title: [paper] From Certified Pairs to a Certified Hub: Reasoner-Checked Crosswalks for the Information Exchange Standard
item.description: Logic-based alignment repair and reasoning techniques are applied to the Information Exchange Standard to construct valid, coherent, and conservative crosswalks and hubs for a national digital twin.

item.title: [paper] Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
item.description: Shared framework adapts Cosmos world foundation models to provide real-time interactive world simulation for training and evaluating Physical AI agents and applications.

item.title: [paper] Learning to Track Cells from Sparse Annotations in 3D Time-Lapse Microscopy
item.description: Cell tracking pipeline integrates sparse annotations, motion and correspondence features, and joint event selection to accurately reconstruct cell lineages in 3D time-lapse microscopy.

item.title: [paper] Dimension-Free Private Mean Estimation is Impossible Without the Covariance
item.description: Research establishes new lower bounds demonstrating that differentially private Gaussian mean estimation cannot achieve dimension-free sample complexity or error bounds when the covariance matrix is unknown.

item.title: [paper] From Reconstruction to Imputation: Test-Time Optimization for Missing Time-Series Channels
item.description: Test-time optimization method converts a frozen sequence reconstructor into an imputer by treating missing time-series entries as optimization variables that minimize reconstruction error on observed coordinates.

item.title: [paper] Alternatives to Shallow Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering
item.description: Hybrid collaborative filtering models that incorporate user-user information outperform standard shallow autoencoders on well-known recommendation system benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency: Test-Time Reasoning with Imperfect Generators and Verifiers
item.description: Stochastic decoding framework called Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency combines step-level correctness and future-outcome estimates to guide language model reasoning and improve multi-step accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Time-Division Multiplexing: The Operational Rhythm and Temporal Organization Layer of Digital Life
item.description: Time-Division Multiplexing framework introduces a temporal organization layer with phase-tagged micro-epochs and nested clocks to help continual agents balance urgent interactions, error replaying, and long-term changes.

item.title: [paper] The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information
item.description: This framework defines an operational behavioral rate to measure the minimum serialized size of a compressed LoRA adapter needed to preserve fine-tuning performance across different base models.

item.title: [paper] A trust layer for fast pedestal-stability surrogates: calibrated error bars, out-of-distribution alarms and few-shot recalibration
item.description: A model-agnostic trust layer for linear peeling-ballooning stability surrogates provides conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms, and few-shot recalibration to improve reliability in fusion device design.

item.title: [paper] SpikePose: Lightweight Video Human Pose Estimation
item.description: SpikePose is a lightweight video human pose estimator combining a single-step spiking encoder with motion-aligned heatmap memory to reduce arithmetic energy consumption by 91.4% compared to equivalent analog networks.

item.title: [paper] BudgetSplat: Budget-Controllable Generalizable Gaussian Splatting
item.description: BudgetSplat is a budget-controllable feed-forward framework that adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting representations to user-specified preservation ratios by jointly optimizing importance, spatial coverage, and cross-view redundancy.

item.title: [paper] Thermodynamics-Informed Learning Captures Hierarchical Hydrogen-Bond Networks in Deep Eutectic Solvents
item.description: TiNN is a thermodynamics-informed neural network that hierarchically models hydrogen-bond networks and free-energy pathways to predict deep eutectic solvent solubility and accelerate solvent screening.

item.title: [paper] Signed, Sealed, Leaked: Trust Beyond Signature for MCP Toolchains
item.description: Germline execution runs Model Context Protocol tool invocations in ephemeral, data-free copies to bound potential information disclosure and prevent unauthorized data leaks from signed third-party tools.

item.title: [paper] Finite-width shift of the edge of chaos in deep neural networks
item.description: This study derives the finite-width shift of the edge of chaos in deep neural networks using a random walk model, yielding a new initialization rule that places networks directly on their critical line.

item.title: [news] Ask HN: What's your current AI agentic setup?
item.description: I'm curious how people on HN are using AI day to day, and came up with a list of questions I thought could be interesting to know. No need to answer every question of course, just wanted to get a gut feel how people are using AI.

item.title: [paper] One Scale, Four Texts: Gaps, Overlaps and Silent Repairs in Published Grading Schemes
item.description: An analysis of four published diabetic retinopathy grading texts using an SMT solver and OWL reasoner reveals widespread gaps, category omissions, and conflicting clinical classifications across different guideline versions.

item.title: [paper] From Fixed Defaults to Calibrated Activation Policies for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
item.description: A calibrated selection policy for long-term time-series forecasting learns from prior training runs to adapt activation functions and their locations to specific tasks, reducing mean squared error.

item.title: [paper] LungMend: A Healthy-Only Latent Diffusion Shape Prior for Lung Mask Correction in Severe Tuberculosis CT
item.description: LungMend is a latent diffusion post-processing model that uses healthy anatomy to correct missing lung structures in severe tuberculosis CT masks. Keyword: LungMend.

item.title: [paper] RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
item.description: RAGAM-AI is a hybrid framework combining reinforcement learning and generative AI to optimize multi-access edge computing resource allocation and manage reward generalization.

item.title: [paper] Addition by Subtraction: Toward Mitigating Fragile Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
item.description: Addition by Subtraction is a fine-tuning method that removes safety-critical neurons and uses preference optimization to strengthen large language model safety alignment against jailbreaks.

item.title: [paper] Adapting Sleep Foundation Models for Dense Sleep Spindle Localization
item.description: Local sleep spindle localization method adapts a frozen SleepFM encoder with a local time-frequency pathway to preserve spectral content and sub-token temporal detail.

item.title: [paper] When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
item.description: Audit framework investigates how long-running large language model agents write self-generated handoff summaries containing unsupported policy restrictions and authorizations.

item.title: [paper] MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
item.description: MKD2World is a spatial markdown world model for desktop web agents that serializes interface elements to predict post-action states and improve decision-making.

item.title: [paper] Using Experience Twice: Dynamic Process Rubrics for Privileged Token-Level Credit Assignment
item.description: Online Rubric Self-Distillation is a reinforcement learning method that derives natural-language process rubrics from trajectory differences to provide fine-grained token-level supervision.

item.title: [paper] EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
item.description: EvoOPD is a black-box on-policy distillation method that adapts teacher feedback strategies to match a student model's evolving learning needs.

item.title: [paper] Spatially and Compositionally Controlled Multimodal Glioblastoma MRI Synthesis with Latent Diffusion
item.description: Two-stage latent diffusion model framework generates controllable 2D glioblastoma MRI scans and tumour segmentation maps conditioned on spatial location and composition.

item.title: [paper] From Admission to Retention: Predicting Durable Offspring in Quality-Diversity Search
item.description: Study on quality-diversity search evaluates pre-reproduction signals to predict durable offspring persistence versus temporary archive entry in automated failure discovery.

item.title: [paper] Deliberate Latent Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
item.description: DESRec is a sequential recommendation framework that uses personalized latent reasoning and a self-distillation mechanism to improve user preference modeling and item ranking accuracy.

item.title: [paper] IDSISA: Influence-Distilled Sharded Training for Efficient Machine Unlearning
item.description: IDSISA is a machine unlearning method that uses influence functions and cross-shard distillation to remove training data influence while maintaining model utility and deletion guarantees.

item.title: [paper] EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
item.description: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target.

item.title: [paper] Dialect Matters: A Dialect-Aware Baseline for Igala-English Machine Translation
item.description: Researchers present a dialect-aware baseline for Igala-English machine translation that uses a new dataset to demonstrate that mixed-dialect training improves translation performance and fairness.

item.title: [paper] An Interaction-Aware Decision Framework for FDIC-Assisted Distressed Bank Acquisitions: Empirical Evidence from the FDIC Failed-Bank Panel and the SVB-First Citizens Case
item.description: The Spider Network Filtering Framework uses graph-inspired interaction rules to help evaluate and make decisions regarding the acquisition of distressed banks assisted by the FDIC.

item.title: [paper] Nowcasting Future Performance for Population Pruning in Survival-of-the-Fittest Training
item.description: Researchers introduce a nowcasting method that uses intermediate training checkpoints to predict future model accuracy, enabling more efficient pruning of candidate models during training.

item.title: [paper] ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events
item.description: ElecLoad is a context-aware agent that analyzes multiple events to adaptively organize and refine electricity load forecasting by partitioning the forecast horizon into segments.

item.title: [paper] NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria
item.description: NaijaFacts is a benchmark for Nigerian factual and statistical questions that helps distinguish between a model's linguistic competence and its actual knowledge of African topics.

item.title: [paper] CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
item.description: CRESiST is an end-to-end speech translation framework that uses an interleaved read-write architecture and an actor-critic policy to optimize quality and latency in streaming translation.

item.title: [paper] Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
item.description: Coca-Cola is a latent context compression model that reduces token consumption and runtime for LLM agents by compressing tool observations into decision-critical latent tokens.

item.title: [paper] Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: Researchers analyze the integrity gap in offline retrieval-augmented generation and propose a verification method for quantization codes to prevent attackers from manipulating retrieval results.

item.title: [paper] LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering
item.description: LibriSpeech-Real-QA is a dataset and benchmark for evaluating how speech large language models perform real-time question answering on streaming audio inputs.

item.title: [paper] FPTR: Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement for Deadline-Constrained Joint Beam and Resource Allocation
item.description: FPTR is a refinement method for wireless schedulers that maintains a feasible beam-and-resource allocation while meeting strict execution deadlines for improved traffic performance.

item.title: [paper] Risk-Sensitive Non-Parametric and Kernel Bandits
item.description: Non-Parametric CPT Bandits is an optimistic algorithm for continuous action spaces that enables risk-sensitive decision-making without increasing the order of regret.

item.title: [paper] Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
item.description: Researchers demonstrate that model merging can achieve higher accuracy by assigning different LoRA ranks to experts based on their specific domain requirements.

item.title: [paper] Object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers: architecture, representation, and acquisition shortcuts
item.description: A study of astronomical image classification shows that model performance is influenced by image context, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived properties of physical objects.

item.title: [paper] What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
item.description: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints.

item.title: [paper] ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
item.description: ArcRAG is a retrieval framework that enables effective multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs without requiring co-design between retrieval and graph construction.

item.title: [paper] The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
item.description: A study on fine-tuning language models reveals that alignment training causes task-selective capability loss, with some tasks degrading significantly more than others.

item.title: [paper] A 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and segmentation
item.description: HoloCT is a 3D foundation model that improves CT scan interpretation and lesion segmentation by jointly modeling clinical text and spatial anatomical data.

item.title: [paper] How many sorted projections determine n points in k dimensions?
item.description: Researchers prove that a logarithmic number of sorted projections is sufficient to uniquely determine a set of points in higher-dimensional spaces.

item.title: [paper] Microdroplet Generator Surrogate Enhancement and Inverse Design Through an Uncertainty-Guided Framework
item.description: An uncertainty-guided framework for microfluidic device design uses adaptive surrogate modeling and simulation to improve the accuracy of droplet diameter predictions.

item.title: [paper] CoDecide: Content-Adaptive Video Decoding for High-Throughput Video Analytics
item.description: CoDecide is a video analytics system that reduces decoding costs by using a compressed-domain student model to identify and decode only frames containing new content.
